info.name: Bookmark API
info.description:
A RESTful API for managing bookmarks with categories and tags. Built with Java 21 and Spring Boot. Register an account, login to get a JWT token, then click Authorize to test protected endpoints.

Contact Support:
 Name: Ahmed Yinusa
 Email: yinusaahmed80@gmail.com
